variants.prompt: Reply to a customer whose order shipped late. Apologize briefly and offer a refund of shipping costs.
variants.output: Sorry your order arrived late. We've refunded your shipping cost — it should post within 3-5 business days.

variants.prompt: Reply to a customer whose order shipped late. Acknowledge their frustration, apologize sincerely, and offer a refund of shipping costs.
variants.output: I'm really sorry your order didn't arrive on time — that's frustrating, especially when you're counting on it. I've gone ahead and refunded your shipping cost; you should see it back on your card within 3-5 business days. Thanks for your patience with us.

variants.prompt: Reply to a customer whose order shipped late. Apologize, cite our shipping SLA policy, and explain the refund process for shipping costs step by step.
variants.output: We apologize for the delay in fulfilling your order. Per our Shipping Service Level Agreement, orders exceeding the quoted delivery window are eligible for a shipping cost refund. To process your refund: (1) our system has flagged your order as SLA-breaching, (2) a refund request has been automatically generated, (3) funds will be returned to your original payment method within 3-5 business days, (4) you will receive a confirmation email once the refund posts. Please retain this correspondence for your records.
